nodes.name: mmu.h
nodes.summary: MMU subsystem public header. Declares mmu_init, mmu_map, mmu_duplicate_pagetable, mmu_free_usermemory, data_abort_handler, TLB invalidation, mmu_map_kernel prototypes.

nodes.name: pci.h
nodes.summary: Header defining PCI device descriptor struct and declaring the pci_init, pci_scan_bus, and driver registration function prototypes.

nodes.name: pipe.c
nodes.summary: UNIX pipe stub. pipe_buffer_t with 4096-byte ring buffer, spinlock, waiter task pointers. All operations stub returning ENOSYS.

nodes.name: pipe
nodes.summary: Creates a pipe by allocating a pipe buffer and registering read/write file descriptors in the current task's file table.

nodes.name: pipe_read
nodes.summary: Reads data from the pipe's circular buffer into the caller's buffer, blocking if no data is available.

nodes.name: pipe_write
nodes.summary: Writes data into the pipe's circular buffer, blocking if the buffer is full.

nodes.name: pipe_poll
nodes.summary: Returns poll event flags indicating whether the pipe has data ready to read or space to write.

nodes.name: pipe_close
nodes.summary: Closes a pipe file descriptor and frees the backing buffer when both ends are closed.

nodes.name: pipe.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring the pipe creation and pipe file operation function prototypes.

nodes.name: select.c
nodes.summary: Kernel implementations of POSIX select() and poll() that iterate open file descriptors and invoke per-file poll callbacks to test readiness.

nodes.name: signal.c
nodes.summary: POSIX-style signal subsystem: supports signal(), sigaction(), kill() with per-task signal bitmask, deliver_signals() called at schedule time, and handle_exception() for AArch64 fault-to-signal translation.

nodes.name: sigaction
nodes.summary: Installs or queries a signal action for the current task, copying old handler to oldact and setting new handler with mask and flags.

nodes.name: kill
nodes.summary: Delivers a signal to a target task by PID, setting the signal bit in the task's pending mask and waking it if blocked.

nodes.name: deliver_signals
nodes.summary: Checks the current task's pending signal bitmask and calls the registered handler or default action for each set signal.

nodes.name: sigreturn
nodes.summary: Restores the saved register context after a user signal handler returns.

nodes.name: handle_exception
nodes.summary: Translates an AArch64 exception (ESR/FAR) into a SIGSEGV or SIGBUS and calls deliver_signals, or halts the system for unrecoverable faults.

nodes.name: register_default_handlers
nodes.summary: Installs default signal handlers for SIGTERM, SIGKILL, and other signals at task creation.

nodes.name: spinlock.c
nodes.summary: AArch64 spinlock implementation using LDXR/STXR exclusive monitor instructions, with IRQ-save/restore variants for use in interrupt-context-safe critical sections.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses AArch64 exclusive monitor (LDXR/STXR) with DMB barriers rather than a simple swap, ensuring correct acquire/release semantics on multi-core systems.

nodes.name: spinlock_init
nodes.summary: Initialises a spinlock to the unlocked state.

nodes.name: spin_lock_irqsave
nodes.summary: Saves and disables IRQs via DAIF then acquires the spinlock with exclusive load/store retry, ensuring IRQ-safe critical sections.

nodes.name: spin_unlock_irqrestore
nodes.summary: Releases a spinlock and restores the saved interrupt flags.

nodes.name: spin_lock
nodes.summary: Acquires the spinlock without saving IRQ state, spinning on LDAXR/STXR until the lock word transitions from 0 to 1.

nodes.name: spin_unlock
nodes.summary: Releases a spinlock acquired with spin_lock.

nodes.name: spinlock.h
nodes.summary: Header defining the spinlock_t type and declaring all spinlock primitive prototypes.

nodes.name: task.c
nodes.summary: POSIX-style process management implementing fork() (clone current task with duplicated page tables), execve() (load ELF binary into user address space), and wait/waitpid for child termination.

nodes.name: fork
nodes.summary: Creates a child task by allocating a new TCB, duplicating the parent's page tables and kernel stack, and enqueuing the child on the current CPU's run queue.

nodes.name: execve
nodes.summary: Loads an ELF binary from VFS into the current task's user address space, sets up program segments via mmu_map, and prepares argv/envp on the user stack before returning to EL0.

nodes.name: usb_storage.c
nodes.summary: USB mass-storage class driver stub: registers a block-device interface over xHCI bulk transfers, translating read/write requests into SCSI CBW/CSW sequences.

nodes.name: vfs.c
nodes.summary: Virtual filesystem layer: provides a uniform read/write/seek/poll/close interface over registered filesystem drivers, implements filesystem mounting, and registers the Filecore (ADFS/FAT32) filesystem driver.

nodes.name: fc_vfs_read
nodes.summary: Filecore-backed VFS read callback: calls filecore_read_file to transfer file data from disc into the caller's buffer, managing intermediate kernel allocations.

nodes.name: fc_vfs_seek
nodes.summary: VFS seek adapter for FileCore files, adjusting the file position with SEEK_SET/CUR/END semantics.

nodes.name: vfs_close
nodes.summary: Dispatches close to the file's ops->close handler.

nodes.name: vfs_read
nodes.summary: Dispatches a read request to the file's ops->read handler.

nodes.name: vfs_write
nodes.summary: Dispatches a write request to the file's ops->write handler.

nodes.name: vfs_seek
nodes.summary: Dispatches a seek request to the file's ops->seek handler.

nodes.name: vfs_poll
nodes.summary: Dispatches a poll query to the file's ops->poll handler.

nodes.name: vfs_register_filesystem
nodes.summary: Registers a filesystem driver by name in the global filesystem table.

nodes.name: vfs_mount
nodes.summary: Mounts a named filesystem at a mount-point by finding the registered driver and calling its mount callback, logging success or failure.

nodes.name: filecore_vfs_readdir
nodes.summary: VFS readdir adapter that walks FileCore directory entries, bridging the FileCore API to the VFS dirent interface.

nodes.name: filecore_vfs_mount
nodes.summary: Filecore VFS mount callback: calls filecore_init to discover and parse the disc record, then filecore_list_root to populate the root directory.

nodes.name: vfs_register_filecore
nodes.summary: Registers the Filecore filesystem driver with the VFS layer and immediately mounts it at the root, making ADFS/FAT32 volumes accessible.

nodes.name: vl805_init.c
nodes.summary: Initialises the VL805 USB 3.0 controller firmware via VideoCore mailbox: sends a notify-xHCI property message to the GPU, which loads VL805 firmware and enables the USB hub.

nodes.name: mbox_read
nodes.summary: Reads a response from the VideoCore mailbox by polling the status register until data is available on the requested channel.

nodes.name: mbox_property
nodes.summary: Sends a single VideoCore mailbox property buffer and blocks until the GPU acknowledges, returning the response payload.

nodes.name: vl805_init
nodes.summary: Sends the NOTIFY_XHCI_RESET mailbox property message to the VideoCore, triggering VL805 USB controller firmware load; logs mailbox base and response status.

nodes.name: vl805_mailbox_test.c
nodes.summary: Test harness for VideoCore mailbox interactions: queries firmware revision, sends the NOTIFY_XHCI_RESET message, and probes USB power/enable tags to validate mailbox communication with the GPU.

nodes.name: mbox_test_tag
nodes.summary: Generic helper that builds a single-tag mailbox request, calls mbox_call, and prints request and response buffers for diagnostic purposes.

nodes.name: mbox_get_fw_rev
nodes.summary: Queries the VideoCore firmware revision via a mailbox property call and logs the result.

nodes.name: mbox_test_notify_xhci
nodes.summary: Constructs and sends the NOTIFY_XHCI_RESET mailbox property message, logging the GPU's response and confirming the VL805 notification succeeded.

nodes.name: mbox_test_usb_tags
nodes.summary: Sends USB power state query tags via the mailbox and logs the power status results.

nodes.name: vl805_mailbox_test
nodes.summary: Top-level test entry point: prints mailbox base address, queries GPU firmware revision, sends NOTIFY_XHCI_RESET, and tests USB-related mailbox tags.

nodes.name: dhcp_test_module.c
nodes.summary: DHCP client test module that exercises the DHCP state machine by injecting synthetic OFFER and ACK packets, verifying correct state transitions and IP assignment.

nodes.name: dhcp_test_module_init
nodes.summary: Module init function that runs a full DHCP exchange sequence, injecting crafted OFFER and ACK buffers and asserting bound/unbound state at each step.

nodes.name: blockdev.h
nodes.summary: Earlier block device header defining a simple blockdev_t struct with per-device read/write function pointers, plus register/unregister/find API declarations; superseded by blockdriver.h with richer media classification.

nodes.name: dl.c
nodes.summary: Implements a minimal dynamic-linker shim for the Phoenix kernel, providing symbol resolution against a built-in table and a dlclose stub.
nodes.languageNotes: Symbol resolution is done via a linear strcmp scan of a compiled-in symbol table rather than ELF relocations at runtime.

nodes.name: dlopen
nodes.summary: Opens an ELF64 shared object via VFS, validates its magic and type, parses PT_DYNAMIC, and registers it in the loaded-library table.

nodes.name: dlsym
nodes.summary: Walks the symbol table of a loaded library to find a named symbol and return its value as a function pointer.

nodes.name: elf64.h
nodes.summary: Defines ELF-64 data structures (Elf64_Ehdr, Elf64_Phdr, Elf64_Shdr, Elf64_Sym, Elf64_Rela, etc.) and associated constants used by the kernel's module loader.

nodes.name: errno.c
nodes.summary: Provides the kernel's POSIX-style errno string table and any errno utility functions for translating error codes to messages.

nodes.name: strerror
nodes.summary: Looks up an error number in the static message table and returns the corresponding POSIX error string, or 'Unknown error' for out-of-range values.

nodes.name: errno.h
nodes.summary: Declares POSIX errno constants and the kernel errno variable for use across kernel subsystems.

nodes.name: error.h
nodes.summary: Defines Phoenix OS error types, error block structures, and macros for error propagation compatible with the RISC OS error-handling convention.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors the RISC OS error block structure (error number + message string) for OS SWI error returns.

nodes.name: irq.h
nodes.summary: IRQ subsystem public header. Defines IRQ vector constants, irq_handler_t, irq_init/set_handler/unmask/eoi prototypes, IPI constants, xhci_irq_pending() inline helper.

nodes.name: kernel_malloc.c
nodes.summary: Implements the kernel heap allocator (kmalloc/kfree) wrapping a simple buddy or slab allocator, with a heap_stats diagnostic function.

nodes.name: kmalloc
nodes.summary: Bump-pointer allocator: advances heap_used by the 16-byte-aligned request size and returns the pre-advance pointer, or NULL on exhaustion.

nodes.name: mmio.c
nodes.summary: Memory-mapped I/O access primitives (readb/readl/readq, writeb/writel/writeq) plus virtual-to-physical and GPU bus address translation helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses volatile pointer casts rather than inline assembly for MMIO to let GCC emit correct load/store barrier semantics on AArch64.

nodes.name: gpu_bus_addr
nodes.summary: Converts a virtual address to a GPU/VC bus address by adding the VideoCore DMA offset used by the Raspberry Pi mailbox interface.

nodes.name: genet.h
nodes.summary: Public header for the BCM2711 GENETv5 Ethernet hardware driver, declaring the polling-mode TX/RX API, diagnostic counter accessors, and the exported MAC address variable.

nodes.name: genet_module.h
nodes.summary: Header defining the PhoenixGENET DCI4 module public API, all DCI4 constants and SWI offsets, and the key data structures (DIB, filter, stats buffer) needed for RISC OS DCI4 compliance.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents the full DCI4 stack: Internet module → DCIShim → PhoenixGENET → BCM2711 hardware.

nodes.name: ethernet.h
nodes.summary: Ethernet header constants (ETH_HDR_LEN, ETH_MTU, EtherType values) and the eth_hdr_t struct, plus big-endian byte-swap helper declarations.

nodes.name: resolver_module.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring the PhoenixResolver SWI chunk constants, the BSD-compatible hostent_t struct, and the public API for resolver_module_init, resolver_module_final, resolver_module_swi, and resolver_gethostbyname.

nodes.name: tcp.c
nodes.summary: Implements PhoenixTCP: a minimal RFC 793 client-side TCP state machine with four static connection slots, SYN/ACK/FIN handling, per-connection 4 KB receive ring buffers, and TCP checksum computation.
nodes.languageNotes: No heap allocation; all TCBs are static. No retransmit timer (suitable for LAN); SYN retransmit driven by tcp_tick() calls from the WIMP loop.

nodes.name: tcp_connect
nodes.summary: Initiates an active TCP open by allocating a TCB slot, assigning an ephemeral local port and ISN, and transmitting the initial SYN segment.

nodes.name: tcp_rx
nodes.summary: Processes incoming TCP segments: matches by local port, handles RST unconditionally, and drives the FSM through SYN_SENT, ESTABLISHED, FIN_WAIT, TIME_WAIT, and CLOSED states.

nodes.name: tcp_write
nodes.summary: Sends data on an established TCP connection; caps at MSS 1460 per call and advances snd_nxt.

nodes.name: tcp_read
nodes.summary: Non-blocking read from the connection receive ring buffer; returns bytes copied or 0 if none available.

nodes.name: udp.c
nodes.summary: Implements PhoenixUDP: TX via ipv4_output with ARP/gateway resolution, and an 8-slot RX ring buffer keyed by destination port accessed via non-blocking udp_recvfrom.

nodes.name: udp_send
nodes.summary: Builds an 8-byte UDP header, resolves the destination MAC via arp_resolve_blocking (with gateway fallback), and hands the datagram to ipv4_output.

nodes.name: udp_rx
nodes.summary: Processes an incoming UDP frame, extracting source IP, ports, and payload, then enqueuing into the destination-port-keyed RX ring.

nodes.name: uart.h
nodes.summary: Minimal UART driver header declaring the five public I/O functions used throughout the kernel for serial diagnostics and boot output.

nodes.name: blockdriver.c
nodes.summary: Block device driver framework implementation providing registration, lookup, LBA read/write/trim/poll/close dispatch through an ops table, and a diagnostic blockdev_print_all function that lists all registered storage devices with type, size, and FileCore scoring.

nodes.name: blockdev_register
nodes.summary: Allocates and registers a new block device descriptor under a spinlock, assigning the next available unit number and adding it to the global device table.

nodes.name: blockdev_get
nodes.summary: Looks up a registered block device by name and optional unit number under a spinlock, returning a pointer to its descriptor or NULL.

nodes.name: blockdev_print_all
nodes.summary: Iterates all registered block devices and prints their name, unit, media class, block size, total size in MB, and computed FileCore disc-scoring value to the debug console.

nodes.name: blockdriver.h
nodes.summary: Public header for the Phoenix block device framework, defining blockdev_t, blockdev_ops_t, the media_class_t enum (UNKNOWN/SD/USB_FLASH/SSD/NVME), and declarations for register/get/print_all and the global device list.

nodes.name: Bits64.c
nodes.summary: Phoenix stub replacing the RISC OS disc reader 64-bit arithmetic helpers with integer-only implementations; provides Zero64, Inc64, Dec64, Cmp64, Add64, Add64_32, Sub64, Sub64_32, and integer-formatted display helpers (Print64, Size32, Size64, Percent64) that avoid floating-point instructions.
nodes.languageNotes: Floating-point is banned by -mgeneral-regs-only in the kernel build; Size64 simply delegates to Size32 since the disc reader only deals with 32-bit-capped sizes in practice.

nodes.name: Bits64.h
nodes.summary: Header providing inline macros and helpers for 64-bit arithmetic on 32-bit word pairs, used throughout the disc reader subsystem for 64-bit address and size manipulation.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements 64-bit operations (INC64, DEC64, ZERO64, ADDR64SEC, etc.) using struct pairs, working around bare-metal AArch64 C toolchain limitations.

nodes.name: dr_types.h
nodes.summary: Defines core types, character classification helpers, and the safe_exit utility for the disc reader subsystem.

nodes.name: dr_realloc
nodes.summary: Bare-metal realloc shim that kmalloc-allocates a new buffer, copies at most 2048 bytes from the old buffer, and kfree-s it; used exclusively by LoadDirectory when growing big-directory buffers.

nodes.name: BootRecord.c
nodes.summary: Reads and writes the ADFS/FileCore disc boot block, parses the on-disc disc record structure, validates checksums, and reads defect lists.

nodes.name: ReadBootBlock
nodes.summary: Reads the disc boot block from the storage device, parses the disc record and defect lists, and initialises global disc geometry state.

nodes.name: GetDiscRecord
nodes.summary: Extracts and decodes the disc record fields from a raw boot block buffer into a structured disc record.

nodes.name: DisplayRecord
nodes.summary: Formats and prints all fields of a disc record to the debug output for diagnostic purposes.

nodes.name: CalcMapLocation
nodes.summary: Calculates the LBA address of the disc map from disc record parameters.

nodes.name: DiscReader.c
nodes.summary: Minimal glue file for the disc reader subsystem containing the ExtractObject helper that copies an object from a sector buffer.

nodes.name: Map.c
nodes.summary: Implements the ADFS new-map parser: reads, decodes, and writes the bit-map zones that track disc allocation, providing ID resolution, free space tracking, and map address arithmetic.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the FileCore new-map format with per-zone cross-zone IDs, bit-level address arithmetic, and zone checksum validation.

nodes.name: ReadMap
nodes.summary: Reads all map zones from disc, allocates zone arrays, and invokes the map record and contents parsers.

nodes.name: ReadMapContents
nodes.summary: Iterates all bit entries in the map zones to classify fragments as free or assigned to object IDs.

nodes.name: AddID
nodes.summary: Registers a disc fragment ID in the in-memory object list, creating a new entry or extending an existing fragmented object's chain.

nodes.name: MakeID
nodes.summary: Allocates a new disc object ID from the free map, setting the appropriate map bits across zones.

nodes.name: MapAddr
nodes.summary: Converts a zone/bit-offset pair to an LBA disc address.

nodes.name: MapZoneCheck
nodes.summary: Verifies the checksum and consistency of a single map zone.

nodes.name: BigFile.c
nodes.summary: Implements platform-portable big-file I/O (open, close, read, write) using 64-bit addressing, bridging RISC OS OSLib SWIs and POSIX/Win32 file APIs for accessing raw disc images larger than 2 GB.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses conditional compilation for __riscos, _WIN32, and POSIX targets; 64-bit seek via _fseeki64 on Windows and off_t on POSIX.

nodes.name: BigFile.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring the BigFile API (open, close, read, write) for 64-bit addressed large disc image files.

nodes.name: BootRecord.c
nodes.summary: Reads, parses, and displays the FileCore boot block and disc record (LBA0), including defect lists, CRC computation, and map location calculation for E and E+ format RISC OS discs.

nodes.name: DirUtils.c
nodes.summary: Comprehensive directory manipulation library supporting both old (Hugo/Nick) and new (BigDir) FileCore directory formats, including load, create, add/remove/find entries, sort, checksum, and RISC OS filename collation.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a full 256-entry static collation table implementing RISC OS filename ordering rules that differ from standard ASCII/locale ordering.

nodes.name: Directories.c
nodes.summary: Recursively reads and validates the directory tree of a FileCore disc, checking each entry against the allocation map and optionally backing up files or extracting objects.

nodes.name: DiscOps.c
nodes.summary: Provides low-level disc I/O operations (byte and sector read/write, SWI dispatch, extract-to-sparse-file) that abstract over live RISC OS drives and raw disc image files.

nodes.name: DiscReader.c
nodes.summary: Main entry point for the DiscReader utility: parses command-line arguments, orchestrates boot block / map / directory reading, and displays statistics and size-distribution tables.

nodes.name: DiscReader.h
nodes.summary: Central header defining all FileCore disc constants, the global s_info program-state structure, struct types for disc record / map objects / free space / directory info, and function prototypes for the entire DiscReader subsystem.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the large s_info aggregate that acts as a global program-state singleton, including nested structs for options, file handle, disc parameters, statistics counters, and space accounting.

nodes.name: Map.c
nodes.summary: Reads and interprets the FileCore allocation map, building in-memory linked-list structures for used and free space extents, and providing utilities for bit manipulation, address translation, and map writing.

nodes.name: Objects.c
nodes.summary: Handles FileCore object (file and directory) loading, saving, extraction, and copying using SIN-based addressing and map chunk traversal; also tracks per-object statistics.

nodes.name: SparceFile.c
nodes.summary: Implements a sparse disc-image container format that stores only written blocks with their 64-bit disc addresses, using a binary-search cache for fast random access during extraction and replay.
nodes.languageNotes: The format stores (addr64, size, data) records sequentially; a sorted in-memory cache enables O(log n) lookup. Note: the filename intentionally preserves the historical 'Sparce' spelling.

nodes.name: SparceFile.h
nodes.summary: Header declaring the SparceFile API for creating, reading, writing, and appending blocks in a sparse disc-image container format identified by the magic bytes 'SPARCE\x00\x01'.

nodes.name: BigFile_Open
nodes.summary: Opens a disc image file for random access using an OSLib file handle.

nodes.name: BigFile_Read
nodes.summary: Reads a block from a 64-bit address in a big disc image file, dispatching to osgbpb on RISC OS or fseek/fread on host platforms.

nodes.name: BigFile_Write
nodes.summary: Writes a block to a 64-bit address in a big disc image file, dispatching to osgbpb on RISC OS or fseek/fwrite on host platforms.

nodes.name: ReadBootBlock
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the LBA0 sector containing the FileCore boot block, extracts the disc record, validates defect lists, and handles 512MB+ disc size checks.

nodes.name: ReadDefectLists
nodes.summary: Parses primary and secondary defect lists from the boot block, printing entries and reporting termination markers.

nodes.name: BootBlockChecksum
nodes.summary: Calculates the FileCore boot block CRC by accumulating a rotating byte sum over the first 511 bytes.

nodes.name: GetDiscRecord
nodes.summary: Deserialises a binary FileCore disc record from a byte buffer into the s_disc_record structure, including 64-bit disc size handling.

nodes.name: DisplayRecord
nodes.summary: Prints all fields of a disc record in human-readable form, including geometry, density type, and optional disc name for map records.

nodes.name: CalcMapLocation
nodes.summary: Calculates the sector address of the first map copy from the disc record geometry.

nodes.name: LoadDirectory
nodes.summary: Allocates memory and loads a FileCore directory object (old or new format), reallocating for large E+ directories.

nodes.name: IsDirectory
nodes.summary: Probes a disc SIN to determine if it refers to a valid FileCore directory, checking magic names and loading large E+ directories as needed.

nodes.name: CreateDir
nodes.summary: Initialises an empty FileCore directory buffer in either old (Hugo/Nick) or new (BigDir) format with correct header fields and initial checksum.

nodes.name: AddEntry
nodes.summary: Inserts a sorted directory entry (old or new format) into a FileCore directory buffer, extending E+ directories if needed.

nodes.name: RemoveEntry
nodes.summary: Removes a directory entry and compacts the directory buffer, shrinking large E+ directories when significant free space is reclaimed.

nodes.name: AdjustNameHeap
nodes.summary: Adjusts name-heap pointers in a BigDir directory after inserting or removing a name, maintaining consistent offsets.

nodes.name: SortDirectory
nodes.summary: Sorts directory entries in FileCore collation order using qsort, rebuilding the E+ name heap in the new entry order.

nodes.name: DirCheckByte
nodes.summary: Computes the FileCore directory integrity check byte by XOR-accumulating a 13-bit-rotated word sum over the directory data.

nodes.name: FindEntry
nodes.summary: Searches a directory for an entry by filename using RISC OS collation, returning its SIN and entry/offset indices.

nodes.name: WriteDirectory
nodes.summary: Updates the directory checksum and writes the directory object back to disc via SaveObject.

nodes.name: GetI
nodes.summary: Reads a 1–4 byte little-endian integer from an unaligned byte offset in a data buffer.

nodes.name: GetS
nodes.summary: Extracts a control-terminated or fixed-length ASCII string from a binary data buffer into a null-terminated C string.

nodes.name: filename_cmp
nodes.summary: Compares two RISC OS filenames using a 256-entry collation table that implements the Filer's observed ordering rules.

nodes.name: ReadDirectory
nodes.summary: Recursively reads all entries in a FileCore directory, validating SINs against the map, optionally extracting or backing up files.

nodes.name: ReadEntry
nodes.summary: Processes a single directory entry, verifying it exists in the allocation map, dispatching to shared/non-shared object readers, and optionally backing up the file.

nodes.name: ReadSharedObject
nodes.summary: Validates and accounts for a shared-sector FileCore object, computing its allocated size and detecting excess fragments.

nodes.name: ReadNonSharedObject
nodes.summary: Validates and accounts for a non-shared FileCore object, summing chunk allocations and tracking fragmentation and rounding statistics.

nodes.name: ReadSubDir
nodes.summary: Constructs the child directory path and recurses into ReadDirectory for a sub-directory entry.

nodes.name: Initialise
nodes.summary: Initialises disc access by opening a disc image file or dynamically resolving the DiscOp SWI name for a live RISC OS filing system, and creates the extract sparse file if needed.

nodes.name: DiscOp
nodes.summary: Invokes a FileCore DiscOp SWI and handles errors, distinguishing fatal conditions (drive empty, bad drive) from recoverable disc errors.

nodes.name: ReadBytes
nodes.summary: Reads bytes from a disc (file or live drive) applying partition offset, dispatching to SparceFile, BigFile, or DiscOp as appropriate.

nodes.name: WriteBytes
nodes.summary: Writes bytes to a disc (file or live drive) applying partition offset, dispatching to SparceFile, BigFile, or DiscOp.

nodes.name: ReadSectors
nodes.summary: Reads sectors from a disc image or live drive, falling back to single-sector reads when a multi-sector DiscOp fails.

nodes.name: WriteSectors
nodes.summary: Writes sectors to a disc image or live drive using the appropriate SparceFile, BigFile, or SectorDiscOp path.

nodes.name: Extract
nodes.summary: Appends a disc block at its 64-bit address to the sparse extraction file, converting between byte and sector addressing.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses command-line options (file, verbose, backup, extract, show flags), orchestrates the full disc-read pipeline (init, boot block, map, objects), and emits final statistics.

nodes.name: Finalise
nodes.summary: Frees all dynamically allocated resources — maps, object structures, free list — and closes the disc image file.

nodes.name: ShowTables
nodes.summary: Displays object and free-space size distribution tables in exponentially increasing size bins.

nodes.name: ShowStats
nodes.summary: Displays a summary table of disc statistics including used/free space, file/directory counts, fragmentation, and map wastage.

nodes.name: ReadMap
nodes.summary: Reads both copies of the FileCore allocation map, computes geometry parameters, builds the object and free-space index, and optionally extracts map sectors.

nodes.name: ReadMapContents
nodes.summary: Decodes the bit-packed allocation map zone by zone, classifying each entry as a file ID, free block, defect, or system file.

nodes.name: WriteMap
nodes.summary: Recalculates all zone check bytes for the modified map and writes it to both map copies on disc.

nodes.name: AddID
nodes.summary: Inserts a map allocation chunk into the object index linked list, maintaining zone-ordered fragment order and accumulating used-space statistics.

nodes.name: MakeID
nodes.summary: Allocates a new file ID from free space in the map, splitting or consuming free blocks and updating free-chain pointers and zone headers.

nodes.name: MapAddr
nodes.summary: Converts a zone number and bit offset to a sector address by applying the LFAU/sector size relationship.

nodes.name: SetBit
nodes.summary: Sets or clears a single bit in a byte array by index.

nodes.name: ReadObjects
nodes.summary: Locates the root directory in the object map and recursively reads the entire directory tree, tracking statistics.

nodes.name: SinAddr
nodes.summary: Converts a FileCore SIN (Sector Index Number) to its sector address by resolving the object's map chunk and applying the sharing offset.

nodes.name: LoadObject
nodes.summary: Loads a FileCore object from disc into a buffer, either as a single shared fragment or by concatenating multiple non-shared map chunks.

nodes.name: SaveObject
nodes.summary: Writes a FileCore object from a buffer back to disc, handling shared and multi-chunk non-shared objects.

nodes.name: ExtractObject
nodes.summary: Copies a FileCore object to the sparse extraction file, preserving its disc address for later replay.

nodes.name: CopyObject
nodes.summary: Copies a FileCore object to a host filesystem file, using a zone-sized buffer and chunked I/O for fragmented or large files.

nodes.name: SparceFile_Find
nodes.summary: Locates the file offset of a disc address block within a sparse file, rebuilding and binary-searching a sorted cache of block headers on first access.

nodes.name: SparceFile_AppendBlock
nodes.summary: Appends a new block to a sparse file, updating the sorted cache and marking superseded blocks as free.

nodes.name: SparceFile_Write
nodes.summary: Writes data to an existing block in a sparse file at the given address, or appends a new block if no matching block is found.

nodes.name: SparceFile_Read

nodes.name: VL805 xHCI Driver Development
nodes.summary: Development arc (Sessions 1–5, boots 1–143+) for the VL805 USB 3.0 host controller connected via BCM2711 PCIe. Key challenges: HSE root cause, CNR deadlock, ERST/ERSTBA caching, MSI collision, firmware-dependent init sequences, and event ring activation.

nodes.name: VL805 ERSTBA Cache Problem
nodes.summary: The VL805 MCU reads ERSTBA from MMIO exactly once during HCRST firmware re-init and caches it permanently. After HCRST the hardware clears the register to 0, making the cache always 0. Solution: relocate ERST to physical address 0 and set RC_BAR2 to cover PCIe address 0.

nodes.name: xHCI Event Ring Working (Boot 143)
nodes.summary: Historic milestone at boot 143: the VL805 event ring started working after 143+ debug sessions. Three undocumented VL805-specific requirements discovered via Circle project disassembly: CMD_INTE before CMD_RS, ERSTSZ=1 before ERSTBA, and ERDP with EHB=1 on init.

nodes.name: DWC2 OTG USB Driver
nodes.summary: Synopsys DWC2 core (revision 2.80a) at 0xFE980000 driving the USB-C OTG port on Raspberry Pi 4. First successful device detection (boot 118) via the OTG port, entirely independent of the VL805 xHCI controller.

nodes.name: BCM2711 GENETv5 Ethernet Driver
nodes.summary: Bare-metal driver for the BCM2711 integrated GENETv5 NIC at MMIO 0xFD580000 with BCM54213PE PHY in RGMII-ID mode. Development arc boots 302–342 culminating in reliable DHCP, ARP, and ICMP ping with sub-4ms RTT. Key rule: ID_MODE_DISABLE=1 to avoid double TX clock delay.

nodes.name: USB Device Enumeration Stack
nodes.summary: xHCI USB enumeration pipeline: Enable Slot, Address Device, GET_DESCRIPTOR. Multi-slot support added in boot 147 with per-slot DMA layout. First device detected at boot 38; full enumeration working after boot 143 event ring fix.

nodes.name: PCIe RC + VL805 Initialization
nodes.summary: BCM2711 PCIe RC initialization sequence for the VL805 USB controller. Critical fixes: RGR1 ordering before MISC_CTRL, mailbox GET_POWER_STATE guard, Memory Space enable before xhci_init, MSI setup, and conditional HCRST based on firmware version detection.

nodes.name: RISC OS Module Loading System
nodes.summary: Phoenix's native RISC OS module infrastructure supporting both AArch64 (bit 30 in init_entry) and ARM32 (stub) modules. Modules loaded from NVMe disc via FileCore/DiscReader or linked directly into kernel. CMunge -64bit pipeline for building new AArch64 modules.

nodes.name: RISC OS SWI Dispatch Infrastructure
nodes.summary: SVC exception handler routes SWI calls to registered module handlers. SWI dispatch via SVC #0 with SWI number in x10 (riscos64-clib convention). Implemented OS SWIs: OS_WriteC/N/S, OS_ReadC, OS_Heap, OS_Module, OS_ChangeEnvironment, OS_ReadMonotonicTime, OS_Mouse, OS_SpriteOp stub.

nodes.name: FileCore/ADFS Disc Access
nodes.summary: Phoenix FileCore implementation for reading RISC OS new-map ADFS discs from NVMe. IDA→LBA resolution via zone maps. DiscReader integration (boot 401+) solved RTL9210 USB-SATA bridge zero-return bug for interleaved reads. Supports filecore_find_path, filecore_read_file, filecore_exec_obey.

nodes.name: Phoenix Network Stack
nodes.summary: Bare-metal TCP/IP stack with DHCP, ARP, ICMP, UDP, TCP, and DNS. PhoenixResolver implements Inet6Sources Resolver SWI chunk 0x46000 for hostname lookup. PhoenixGENET registered as DCI4 module EtherGENET. All blocking poll loops must drive GENET RX ring directly.

nodes.name: SDIO CYW43455 WiFi/BT Driver
nodes.summary: SDIO Phase 1 driver for CYW43455 WiFi+BT chip via BCM2711 SlowArasan at 0xFE300000 (EMMC0). GPIO 34-39 ALT3, bus power 3.3V, CMD0→CMD5→CMD3→CMD7→CCCR probe. Phase 2 (firmware download, brcmfmac SDIO protocol) ongoing as of boot 492.

nodes.name: xHCI DMA Buffer Layout
nodes.summary: 264KB DMA region at 0x080b3000–0x080f5000 (Normal-NC, MMU identity map) containing DCBAA, cmd_ring, evt_ring, MSI landing pad, ERST, scratchpad array/pages, input/output contexts, EP0 ring and data buffer. DMA_OFFSET=0 (identity mapping after boot 22 RC_BAR2 fix).

nodes.name: VL805/BCM2711 Hardware Rules Compendium
nodes.summary: 120+ numbered hardware rules accumulated across 400+ boot iterations. Covers VL805-specific HCRST sequences, ERST/ERSTBA ordering, PORTSC write safety, CNR firmware dependency, RGMII clock delay, AArch64 ABI vararg limits, and SDIO controller address mapping.

nodes.name: CursorModule — RISC OS Pointer/Input Manager
nodes.summary: Kernel-linked AArch64 RISC OS module managing mouse pointer sprite and keyboard input. Built via CMunge -64bit pipeline and linked directly into kernel ELF. Required LDR+BLR fix for external calls (BL offsets are invalid after heap copy), and linker.ld fix to place cursor_module_start inside section braces.

nodes.summary: ARM32 RISC OS modules loaded from disc (ABIMod, Colours, IconBorderFob, LanMan98) are registered as stubs with Init() deferred. Full AArch32 EL0 execution requires mode-switching infrastructure not yet implemented as of boot 438.

nodes.name: USB Mass Storage (NVMe via RTL9210)
nodes.summary: NVMe SSD connected via RTL9210B USB-NVMe bridge accessed through xHCI bulk transfers. RTL9210 has a zero-return bug for interleaved zone/data reads (resolved by DiscReader integration). Endpoint recovery (ep_recover) required for BOT reset during cold-start.
